summary.text: If you do not go through Singapore immigration before your next flight, you do not need documents.

details.heading: When documents are not needed
details.body: You do not need to provide documents if you stay in transit and do not bring the ashes into Singapore.

example_phrasings: I will be transiting through Singapore to bring ashes to another country
Do I need documents for ashes during transit?
What are the procedures for carrying ashes through Singapore?

sources.page_title: I will be transiting through Singapore to bring the ashes of my deceased relative located overseas to another country. What are the procedures involved?

quotes.text: You are not required to produce documentation if you are not clearing through Singapore’s immigration counter before your next flight
as you will only be in transit and will not be bringing the ashes into Singapore.
